title: Keeping a Promise
paragraphs: Iqbal promises a friend that he will help him move furniture on Saturday morning. When Saturday comes, Iqbal feels extremely tired after a poor night's sleep and briefly considers canceling at the last minute.
Instead, he remembers that he gave his word, and a promise should not depend on how he feels that day. He gets up, makes coffee, and drives over to help his friend as planned.
The moving job takes almost four hours, longer than either of them expected, and Iqbal is exhausted by the end of it, yet he stays until every last box is carried inside the new apartment.

His friend later tells him how much the help meant, especially since another person had cancelled without any warning. Iqbal understands that keeping small promises consistently is what actually builds real trust between people.
